verdict.rationale: Jev is an API and SDK service, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question to ask, but the evidence never documents one in the SDKs, the console or the API. The closest items are a statement that Jev is not trained on customer requests and a mention of zero data retention for enterprise customers. These cover adjacent data-handling policies, not a user-facing opt-out from telemetry or usage tracking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
